
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/axing/p/19128750" title="发布于 2025-10-07 18:39">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">c#造个轮子--GIF录制工具</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 在以往几篇文章里面，大家都可以看到各种录制的GIF效果图，把gif放在文章开始，不仅可以减少很多冗余的解释白话文，更可以让读者一览无余看到文章大概要义。</p>
<p>以往都是使用“LicEcap”来录制的，那么我们是否能自己实现一个这样的工具呢？一方面国庆假期结束，练练代码手感，另一方面可以根据自己需求扩展需要的功能。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>0</strong><strong class="autonum" title="" data-original-title="">1</strong><strong class="135brush" data-brushtype="text">介绍软件UI及操作</strong></p>
<p>操作比较简单，以下是运行界面：</p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p>选择录制区域，绘制需要录制的ROI区域&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>点击开始录制</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>录制结束后，停止录制即可.弹出保存路径保存gif</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://bexp.135editor.com/files/users/813/8134288/202510/6jkxOCcq_hVAD.png?auth_key=1760284799-0-0-cc958bfce33c5e1b591d594460ff91d2" alt="image.png" data-ratio="0.5026041666666666" data-w="384"></p>
<p><strong>0</strong><strong class="autonum" title="" data-original-title="" data-num="2">2</strong><strong>效果图</strong></p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p>整个运行作业图</p>
<p><img src="https://bexp.135editor.com/files/users/813/8134288/202510/Gh8fSGsD_CTcD.gif?auth_key=1760284799-0-0-77e1e725eed0d7df0fe44171c770cc60" alt="test.gif" data-ratio="0.4791035735917626" data-w="1651"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>实际录屏的ROI区域效果GIF</p>
<p><img src="https://bexp.135editor.com/files/users/813/8134288/202510/qnLk78FH_t7D3.gif?auth_key=1760284799-0-0-a404b42b26c4dc985ab026d71062bbc0" alt="eee.gif" data-ratio="0.4970857618651124" data-w="1201"></p>
</li>
</ol><strong>0</strong><strong class="autonum" title="" data-original-title="" data-num="3">3</strong><strong><strong>源码介绍</strong></strong>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202510/116076-20251007183726557-172866994.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<pre class="_135editor" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0"><code>private void InitializeComponents()<br> {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Text = "GIF录制工具";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Size = new Size(400, 200);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterScreen;<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; // 选择区域按钮<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Button btnSelectArea = new Button();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnSelectArea.Text = "选择录制区域";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnSelectArea.Size = new Size(120, 30);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnSelectArea.Location = new Point(20, 20);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnSelectArea.Click += BtnSelectArea_Click;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Controls.Add(btnSelectArea);<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; // 开始录制按钮<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Button btnStart = new Button();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnStart.Text = "开始录制";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnStart.Size = new Size(120, 30);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnStart.Location = new Point(20, 60);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnStart.Click += BtnStart_Click;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Controls.Add(btnStart);<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; // 停止录制按钮<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Button btnStop = new Button();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnStop.Text = "停止录制";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnStop.Size = new Size(120, 30);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnStop.Location = new Point(20, 100);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; btnStop.Click += BtnStop_Click;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Controls.Add(btnStop);<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; // 帧率选择<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Label lblFrameRate = new Label();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; lblFrameRate.Text = "帧率:";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; lblFrameRate.Location = new Point(160, 65);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; lblFrameRate.Size = new Size(50, 20);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Controls.Add(lblFrameRate);<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; NumericUpDown numFrameRate = new NumericUpDown();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; numFrameRate.Value = frameRate;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; numFrameRate.Minimum = 1;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; numFrameRate.Maximum = 30;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; numFrameRate.Location = new Point(210, 65);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; numFrameRate.Size = new Size(60, 20);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; numFrameRate.ValueChanged += (s, e) =&gt; { frameRate = (int)numFrameRate.Value; };<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Controls.Add(numFrameRate);<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; // 状态标签<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Label lblStatus = new Label();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; lblStatus.Text = "状态: 就绪";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; lblStatus.Location = new Point(160, 25);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; lblStatus.Size = new Size(200, 20);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; lblStatus.Name = "lblStatus";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Controls.Add(lblStatus);<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; // 录制计时器<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; captureTimer = new System.Windows.Forms.Timer();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; captureTimer.Tick += CaptureTimer_Tick;<br> }</code></pre>
<p>选择ROI录屏区域</p>
<pre class="_135editor" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0"><code>private void StartAreaSelection()<br> {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Hide();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Thread.Sleep(500); // 等待窗体隐藏<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; isSelectingArea = true;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Cursor = Cursors.Cross;<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; // 创建全屏透明窗体用于区域选择<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Form selectionForm = new Form();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.WindowState = FormWindowState.Maximized;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.None;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.BackColor = Color.Black;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.Opacity = 0.3;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.TopMost = true;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.Cursor = Cursors.Cross;<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Rectangle selectedArea = Rectangle.Empty;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; bool isDragging = false;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; Point dragStart = Point.Empty;<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.MouseDown += (s, e) =&gt;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; isDragging = true;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; dragStart = e.Location;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; };<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.MouseMove += (s, e) =&gt;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (isDragging)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; int x = Math.Min(dragStart.X, e.X);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; int y = Math.Min(dragStart.Y, e.Y);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; int width = Math.Abs(e.X - dragStart.X);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; int height = Math.Abs(e.Y - dragStart.Y);<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; selectedArea = new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.Invalidate();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; };<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.MouseUp += (s, e) =&gt;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left &amp;&amp; isDragging)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; isDragging = false;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (selectedArea.Width &gt; 10 &amp;&amp; selectedArea.Height &gt; 10)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; recordingArea = selectedArea;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; UpdateStatus($"已选择区域: {recordingArea}");<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.Close();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; };<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.Paint += (s, e) =&gt;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (isDragging &amp;&amp; !selectedArea.IsEmpty)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; using (Pen pen = new Pen(Color.Red, 2))<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; e.Graphics.DrawRectangle(pen, selectedArea);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; string sizeText = $"{selectedArea.Width} x {selectedArea.Height}";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; using (Font font = new Font("Arial", 12))<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; using (Brush brush = new SolidBrush(Color.Red))<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; e.Graphics.DrawString(sizeText, font, brush, selectedArea.X, selectedArea.Y - 20);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; };<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.KeyDown += (s, e) =&gt;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Escape)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.Close();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; };<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.FormClosed += (s, e) =&gt;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; {<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; isSelectingArea = false;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Cursor = Cursors.Default;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; this.Show();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; this.BringToFront();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; };<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; selectionForm.ShowDialog();<br> }</code></pre>
<p>录制结束，保存GIF</p>
<pre class="_135editor" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0"><code>private void SaveGif()<br> &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;if (frames.Count == 0)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;MessageBox.Show("没有可保存的帧！", "提示", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;return;<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;using (SaveFileDialog saveDialog = new SaveFileDialog())<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;saveDialog.Filter = "GIF 文件|*.gif";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;saveDialog.Title = "保存GIF文件";<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;saveDialog.DefaultExt = "gif";<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;if (saveDialog.ShowDialog() == DialogResult.OK)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;try<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 使用GifBitmapEncoder替代方案<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;SaveFramesAsGif(frames, saveDialog.FileName, frameRate);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;MessageBox.Show($"GIF保存成功！\n文件: {saveDialog.FileName}\n帧数: {frames.Count}", "成功",<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;catch (Exception ex)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;MessageBox.Show($"保存GIF时出错: {ex.Message}", "错误", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 清理资源<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;foreach (var frame in frames)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;frame.Dispose();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;frames.Clear();<br> &nbsp;}</code></pre>
<pre class="_135editor" data-tools="135编辑器" data-role="code" data-language="csharp" data-theme="vs" data-warp="0" data-line="0"><code>private void SaveFramesAsGif(List&lt;Bitmap&gt; frames, string filePath, int frameRate)<br> &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;using (var collection = new MagickImageCollection())<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;foreach (var frame in frames)<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;using (var memoryStream = new MemoryStream())<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;{<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;frame.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Bmp);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;memoryStream.Position = 0;<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;var image = new MagickImage(memoryStream);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;image.AnimationDelay =Convert.ToUInt32( 100 / frameRate); // 设置帧延迟<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;collection.Add(image);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br><br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// 优化GIF<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;collection.Optimize();<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;collection.Write(filePath);<br> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;}<br> &nbsp;}</code></pre>
<p>主要用到第三方nuget包</p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-2">
<li>
<p>AnimatedGif</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Magick.NET-Q16-AnyCPU</p>
</li>
</ol><strong class="135brush" data-brushtype="text">结束语</strong>
